note: explicit_confirm takes a yes only when the whole reply is four words or fewer, so the six-word "Yes, that's right, please go ahead." is unclear, and under F a model yes can't commit, so the patient is re-asked and handed off. The trap: this is the reference arm's consent rule, frozen with the driver. Changing it breaks the reference, and the loosened rule exists only as arm F2 (dcitl_f2.clear_confirm), where it exposes T15: the same five move patients get wrong bookings (0 under F as frozen, 9 with the rule loosened, measured at case build). Ruled in clinicbench docs/cells-runbook.md, Stage 6 F2 ("F's four-word rule turned that six-word yes down"; neither defect changed). The right answer is a finding that changes nothing.
